about: Established in Dubai, UAE, EMSOL Engineering & Contracting brings together a dedicated team driven by a passion for delivering innovative solar energy solutions, reliable power quality services, advanced harmonic and IR thermography analysis, and comprehensive LV electrical works for industrial, commercial, and residential clients.

Aligned with the Dubai Clean Energy Strategy, we provide: – End-to-end Solar PV EPC contracting services, – Power Quality (PQ); harmonic measurement and analysis, – Supply and installation of EV charging solutions.
